item: Catalogue: the declared language of 23 sources corrected (field analysis 2026-11)
summary: For 23 entries the script of the stored text contradicted the declared language on most of up to 12 instance snapshots and a stored title confirmed the right one (e.g. RIA Novosti and Meduza en->ru, Independent Arabia ar->en). Articles inherit the source language, so they were stored under the wrong one. language is catalogue-owned: existing installs get it through sync_catalogue_corrections, operator edits kept; no re-extraction. 16 ambiguous mismatches stay in the report.
